title: The Last Trail
author: Vesper Dunmore
blurb: Oscar Dravenmoor, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
